name: 2024-2c-recuperatorio-parcial1-masked
title: Kiln Stacker (reduced scope)
description: A simplified kiln-stacking simulator on a walled column of at least 4x5 whose state is checked through a string representation. In this reduced scope the student models the simulator and the five glazed-tile clusters (chosen by a random number), the advance that moves the current cluster down one course, moving it left and right, and the rule that clusters cannot leave the kiln.

design.notes: The five cluster shapes invite five subclasses or five sets of offsets, the random number must be mapped to a cluster without a case statement, and the kiln rendering to strings plus the anchor-position convention must be designed from nothing.
